# laravelforge_ssh_keys (Resource)

Manages an SSH key on a Forge server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_ssh_keys" "deploy" {
  organization = "my-org"
  server       = 123456
  name         = "deploy-key"
  key          = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
  user         = "forge"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The public SSH key.
- `name` (String) The name of the SSH key.
- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `server` (Number) The server ID

### Optional

- `user` (String) The user associated with the SSH key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The date the key was created.
- `created_by` (Number) The user that created the key.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) The date the key was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_ssh_keys.example my-org/123456/123
```
